مُقَذَّذٌ and ↓ مَقْذُوذٌ , Trimmed, or decorated; (M, K;) applied to a man. (M.) See مَقْذُوذٌ ―
-b2- [Hence,] مُقَذَّذٌ (M, K) and ↓ مَقْذُوذٌ (L), A man (M, L) having his hair clipped (M, L, K) round the part where its growth terminates, before and behind: (M, L:) and مُقَذَّذٌ الشَّعَرِ, (S, L,) and ↓ مَقْذُوذُهُ , (L,) A man having his hair trimmed. (S, L.) ―
-b3- مُقَذَّذٌ Anything made even, and fine, or delicate, or elegant. (K.) ―
-b4- [Hence,] A man having a clean garment, one part of it resembling another, every part of it goodly. (L.) And A man of light form, or figure; (Yaakoob, S, M, L, K;) as also مُزَلَّمٌ: and in like manner مُقَذَّذَةٌ, A woman not tall; also مُزَلَّمَةٌ. (Yaakoob, S, M, * L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
